items.name: Greatclub
items.description: While many greatclubs are intricately carved, others are little more than a sturdy tree branch. These massive clubs are too heavy to wield with only one hand.

items.name: Longbow
items.description: This 5-foot-tall bow, usually made of a single piece of elm, hickory, or yew, has a powerful draw and is excellent at propelling arrows with great force and at an extreme distance. You must use two hands to fire a longbow, and it can't be used while mounted.

defensiveAbilities.name: Banished from the Ground
defensiveAbilities.description: A baykok can't willingly touch earth or rock surfaces. If forced into contact with such a surface, it becomes Enfeebled 2 for as long as it remains incontact.

defensiveAbilities.name: Frightful Presence
defensiveAbilities.description:
120 feet. DC 25 Will Saving Throw

See rules...

A creature that first enters the area must attempt a Will save.

Regardless of the result of the saving throw, the creature is temporarily immune to this monster's Frightful Presence for 1 minute.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected by the presence.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The creature is Frightened 4.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

offensiveAbilities.name: Arrow of Despair
offensiveAbilities.description:
A baykok creates an invisible arrow of bone as it draws its bow. A Frightened creature hit by the arrow is stricken with loneliness and despair and must attempt a DC 26 Will Saving Throw save; if the Strike was a critical hit, the target uses the outcome one degree of success worse than the result of its save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Slowed 1 for 1 round.

Failure The creature's frightened value increases by 1 (to a maximum of 4), and it is slowed 1 until its frightened condition ends.

Critical Failure As failure, but the creature is Paralyzed until its frightened condition ends. At the start of each of its turns, it can end the paralyzed condition early with a successful DC 26 Will Saving Throw save.

offensiveAbilities.name: Devour Life
offensiveAbilities.description:
Requirements The baykok is adjacent to a Paralyzed, Restrained, or Unconscious living humanoid.

Effect The baykok touches the target and devours part of its life force. The target must succeed at a DC 26 Fortitude Saving Throw save or be afflicted with the baykok's wasting curse. If the target fails and wasn't already affected by the wasting curse, the baykok gains 20 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 hour.

offensiveAbilities.name: Wasting Curse
offensiveAbilities.description:
The baykok steals life from its victim and leaves listless dread in its place.

If a target fails its save against Devour Life, it becomes Drained 1.

Each time the target gets a full night's rest, it must succeed at a DC 26 Fortitude Saving Throw save or its drained value increases rather than decreasing. The curse ends if the creature recovers from the drained condition, but if the creature would reach drained 5 from this effect, it dies.
